description: Find a course on Studocu by name or code, to get its course_id for search-documents, get-course-syllabus, or get-course-mastery. Pass institution_id from search-institutions when you know the school. Show the user the name, code, and school, not the id. If several results are plausible, ask the user to pick.

institution_id.description: Numeric school id from search-institutions (the id field). Example: 42. Omit to search every school. Prefer setting it when you already know the school.

limit.description: How many courses to return. Integer from 1 to 10. Default 3.

query.description: Course name or code, 1-200 characters after trimming. Example: "ECON101" or "Introduction to Psychology".

name: search-courses
title: Search Courses
